men.summary: Two games into the 2026-27 season, the Bluejays are 2-0 at home with convincing wins over Kansas City (76-61) and Le Moyne (83-55), though Big East play and any Quadrant 1 opportunities are still ahead. With a NET ranking of 83 (and an RPI of 35) and no résumé-defining games yet, their postseason outlook is wide open and will hinge on how they fare against the tougher non-conference slate and the conference schedule.

women.summary: The Bluejays are 1-0 after a 73-71 road win at South Dakota State on Nov 2, which counts as a Quadrant 1 victory, though the No. 1 RPI is a one-game artifact and the NET ranking of 91 is a more realistic read. With Big East play yet to begin (0-0), their postseason outlook is open, and a strong conference showing would be needed to lift that NET number into at-large range.
